name: context-health
description: Cross-agent context health: warns when a session's context is large enough to degrade the running model, and when the startup (initial) context is already too large for the model and platform, using research-derived per-model bands that refresh themselves (evergreen). Hooks for Claude Code, Copilot CLI, VS Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor; a Claude Code status line; an on-demand skill; a terminal report.
